environment.description: Same Ktor microservice on ECS Fargate connecting to Aurora PostgreSQL 14.9. The database connection is established through a pg_bouncer sidecar (transaction pooling mode). The PostgreSQL role used is 'app_ro_7f3a' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'pg-restricted-role' v2.4.1 with parameter grant_type='readonly'. The role's effective permissions are derived from: (1) GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_ro_7f3a, (2) ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_ro_7f3a, (3) REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM app_ro_7f3a followed by GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_ro_7f3a. The role has pg_read_all_data membership but explicitly has no pg_write_all_data. Note: pg_bouncer does NOT perform query filtering - it only handles connection pooling. The role also has NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT set, though NOINHERIT is overridden at session level for the pg_read_all_data grant via SET ROLE.
